name: City and County of San Francisco - Digital Accessibility and Inclusion Standard (DAIS)
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (policy aims for the latest WCAG AA as a minimum)

laws.cite: COIT Digital Accessibility and Inclusion Standard (adopted Nov 18, 2021)
laws.summary: Citywide standard requiring accessible, plain-language, translated public-facing digital content from all departments.

policy_docs.title: SF.gov - Digital Accessibility and Inclusion Standard
Controller's City Services Auditor memo - City not on track to meet DAIS goals (2024)

applies_to: Public-facing digital content operated by or created for the City, its departments, commissions and officials: websites, mobile apps, digital tools.

deadlines.what: Title II date as extended (SF's page still shows the original 2026-04-24).

requires: Each department names a DAIS Coordinator
Accessibility statement on department sites, translated into threshold languages
procurement: Office of Contract Administration integrates accessibility into bids and contracts; vendors must meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
enforcement: COIT governance and Controller audits; federal Title II.
notes: SF page says COIT would update the standard by April 2026 to cover internal content and timelines; no update was found. Controller memo URL from search results, not opened.
